name: banking_routing
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the message about? Pick the single best-matching issue.

criteria.activate_card: Activating a new card or a card that has arrived
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account, accounts for children/teens
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay (setting up, topping up with them)
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs accept the card, where the card can be used to withdraw cash
criteria.automatic_top_up: Auto top-up feature: setting it up, how it works
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: Balance not updated after a cheque or cash deposit
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Can't add a beneficiary / beneficiary not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling or reversing a bank transfer the customer sent (not a purchase)
criteria.card_expiring: Card about to expire, renewing an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted by merchants
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet, tracking card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, or whether / how a card can be sent to a particular country or address
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app, or re-adding / reactivating / reusing a card the customer had reported lost and has since found
criteria.card_payment_fee: An extra fee charged on a card payment
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment on the statement the customer doesn't recognise / didn't make
criteria.card_payment_wrong_fx: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card purchase abroad / in foreign currency
criteria.card_swallowed: ATM swallowed, kept or took the card, or the customer lost access to their card while withdrawing
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Fee charged for an ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal appears in the app or statement that the customer didn't make, or that they never received the cash for
criteria.change_pin: Changing or resetting the card PIN
criteria.compromised_card: Card details or PIN may be compromised or known to someone else
criteria.country_support: Whether people living in a particular country (or outside the UK) are eligible to sign up or be offered an account or card; which countries the bank, account or card works in or can be used in
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or not allowed, including when the customer calls their declined payments 'transfers'
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer doesn't recognise, or wants to dispute or get refunded
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on disposable virtual cards, how many uses
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or other personal details on the account
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used / how rates are determined
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained extra charge (e.g. £1) on the statement
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding/exchanging
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical card / PIN for a new card
criteria.spare_card: Getting a spare or additional card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Card lost, missing or stolen (reporting it, what to do, getting a replacement); also theft of the customer's wallet/belongings
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone lost or stolen, protecting the account
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot app passcode, locked out of the app
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal still shows as pending, hasn't posted, or the balance looks wrong after an ATM withdrawal
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many attempts
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money / salary into the account
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund from a merchant hasn't appeared yet
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase, or wants to cancel a purchase from a merchant
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment to a merchant was cancelled, reverted or returned to the account and the customer asks why
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: Which cards and currencies can be used to top up or pay
criteria.top_up_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_card_charge: Fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_cash_cheque: Topping up / depositing with cash or a cheque
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted or cancelled
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up with a card
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: Charged twice / duplicate or multiple charges for the same transaction (even if the payment was declined)
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / add money
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, documents needed
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying, proving or finding out where the customer's funds / money came from (source of funds)
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification code / verifying a card top-up
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: At the ATM the customer got the wrong amount of cash, less than requested, or received no cash at all
criteria.wrong_fx_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate on a cash withdrawal abroad
criteria.unknown_incoming_money: Money suddenly appeared in the account that the customer says they didn't put there and isn't theirs
criteria.money_missing: Money seems to have disappeared or is missing from the balance, without naming any specific transaction, charge or withdrawal
